text: pañcasikho ceva sārīputto ca rāhulo saññojanaṃ upādānaṃ vaggo tena pavuccatīti . _____________ gahapativaggo tatiyo [191] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ . atha kho uggo gahapati vesāliko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami .pe. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uggo gahapati vesāliko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti . ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme
